# Continual-ARC puzzle solving

    """Overlay the two panels around the color-4 divider; mark occupied cells 3."""
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:divider], grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom) or any(len(a) != len(b) for a, b in zip(top, bottom)):
        raise ValueError("panels must have matching dimensions")
    return [[3 if a != 0 or b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(arow, brow)]
            for arow, brow in zip(top, bottom)]
